title: error/1: why `mzlab-cli` stopped
description: On stdout, next to the text of stderr, for every non-zero exit under `--json` and for every command whose stdout is JSON. `code` is the exit code (1 data or domain error, 2 usage, 3 plan, schema or integrity, 4 input missing or unreadable, 5 selector not found, 6 output write or external source failure, 7 internal error: a panic, a bug); `error_key` and `params` are those of the error (`err.*` keys of the engine and of the command line); `message` is the text without `error: ` and the final newline; `command` names the command that failed; `problems` only for a plan that is not valid; `report` only when the command had printed a document before failing. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/contract.rs, exit.rs.

path.description: where the problem sits in the plan: INSTANCE.params.NAME, INSTANCE.in.PORT, INSTANCE, or steps

report.description: The document the command had printed before it failed (a flowrun/1 report, a validate listing, a partial answer), when it printed one.
